config.label: Base URL of the unlocalhost instance to talk to
config.description: Base URL of the unlocalhost instance to talk to. Defaults to the hosted instance. Set this to point the tools at your own self hosted deployment.

config.label: API token
config.description: API token. Normally written by the unlocalhost_login tool after you approve the device in a browser, so you should not need to set this by hand.
